concept_graph.summary: Each element on a screen of the Flutter app is a widget. Each widget is a part of a user interface. Widgets can be used to build simple and complex layouts.
Widget Tree is used to position widgets within each other to build simple and complex layouts. It is used to render the widgets on the screen.
Material Design is an open-source design system built and supported by Google designers and developers. It is used to implement the Material Design guidelines in Flutter apps.
A stateless widget is used when the widget does not change, such as a static company logo. It is one of the two types of widgets in Flutter.
A stateful widget is used when the widget updates, such as a counter that updates when a button is pressed. It is one of the two types of widgets in Flutter.
Layout management is used to place widgets on the screen as needed. It is a category of widgets that helps in building the user interface of a Flutter app.
Flutter architecture refers to the overall structure of a Flutter app, including the use of widgets, widget trees, and material design. It is used to build cross-platform apps.
